title: F126.3.3 the page a conversation names: the overview
caption: Five parts: a page read on the server as a visitor's message carries it, a route that answers it, the run asking the route, the page kept with the run's recordings, and a live run that proves it. No screen is added.

cards.title: F126.3.3 The page
cards.code: the agent reads what a visitor reads
cards.text: A conversation names the page its visitor is on, and the run sends that page with the first ask.

cards.title: Read server-side
cards.text: A rendered page becomes its address, title, words, places, links and focus.

cards.title: A route answers
cards.text: Open, beside the site's search, and a page is rendered once per address.

cards.title: The run asks
cards.text: Before a conversation's first ask, and the page goes with that ask only.

cards.title: Kept to replay
cards.text: A live play keeps the page under its trial. A replay sends it and asks no one.

cards.title: Proved live
cards.text: One paid run of the guide records again, and the widget's reading is compared.
